## Where I am
HubSpot owner + ARR sync was reworked from webhooks to a CRM search polling job running every 15 minutes, with windowed paging to pass the 10k search limit and a server-side filter for `arr > 0` so trials are skipped. PR #409 was opened with auto-merge enabled, but per the captured GitHub state it is still open: the e2e check `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` fails because the fixture's third company has no ARR, so only 2 rows show an owner. PR #405 was closed as superseded by the polling approach.

- [in-progress] Fix the e2e fixture in `tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py` (give the third company ARR > 0 or expect 2 rows)
- [next-step] Re-run the e2e checks on PR #409 and let auto-merge land
- [next-step] Noa to add `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging and prod
- [failed] `POST /webhooks/v3/{appId}/subscriptions` returned 401 — private app tokens cannot manage webhook subscriptions
- [failed] First paging implementation hit the 10,000-result search cap on the initial backfill; fixed by windowed queries on `hs_lastmodifieddate`
- [decision] Use polling every 15 minutes instead of webhooks; new branch was fine (source: t04)
- [decision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0, skipping trials entirely (source: t10)
